description.value: Whistler RV Park sits just outside the village with ridge views of the Whistler Valley and Black Tusk; a well-amenitied commercial campground with an on-site café, watercraft rentals, and games facilities that skew heavily toward RVs and glamping guests rather than touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides strong evidence of an active, full-service campground. Key amenities confirmed via website text include an on-site café (Brew Mountain Eatery), coin-operated laundry open 24 hours, and online booking ('Book Now' button). OSM's internet_access=wlan and tents=yes tags are corroborated by the website's mention of WiFi and tent/glamping accommodations. No address or phone appear in OSM, but the website prominently shows 1 604 905 2523.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Campgrounds' (plural) while the website consistently uses 'Campground' (singular).
No address recorded in OSM tags.
No phone number recorded in OSM; website displays 1 604 905 2523.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A clearly operating, well-amenitied campground in Whistler with tent sites, on-site food, laundry, WiFi, and online booking — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky route.
